text:
raj.k: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners + timelines for the rollout/canary fixes. Main asks: 1) auto-rollback policy + safe abort path, 2) tighter flag scoping + default-off for risky flags, 3) blast-radius test plan and quota timers. recurring pattern: bad flag default + wide rollout => spike.

sophia: I can take auto-rollback. Plan: implement an execution-level rollback that triggers on composite signals (error-rate, p50 latency). ETA 2w. Will open design doc today. :+1:

ana: I'll own flag scoping and metadata. Proposal: require impact_scope and safe_default on all flags; default false for any flag touching inference or routing. ETA 1w. Will add validation in flag-service.

mike: I'll handle the blast-radius test harness and quarantine timers. Need a small chaos script + staging canary runner. ETA 10 days. Need env creds to run larger experiments — can someone from infra grant access? @eng-infra? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Created tickets: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-1245|INF-1245> assigned to sophia (auto-rollback); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-1246|INF-1246> assigned to ana (flag scoping); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-1247|INF-1247> assigned to mike (blast-radius tests).

raj.k: Thanks — two quick asks: 1) owners add an explicit rollback SLO (e.g., rollback within 3m of trigger detection) & tests proving it, 2) add a short runbook for manual kill-switch and how to quarantine traffic. Can we have ETAs in the ticket by EOD tomorrow?

ana: Added to INF-1246: flag schema snippet and validation tasks. Example metadata we want: 
```
{
  "flag_name": "llm_rewrite_v2",
  "impact_scope": "routing|all-tenants|high",
  "safe_default": false,
  "rollout_strategy": "staged",
  "owners": ["ana"]
}
```
I'll add the validator PR + migration task.

sophia: For auto-rollback signal, proposing Prom rule: 
```
alert: AutoRollbackCandidate
expr: increase(request_errors_total[5m]) / increase(requests_total[5m]) > 0.005 or avg_over_time(latency_p50[5m]) > 2 * baseline_p50
for: 3m
labels: { "severity": "critical" }
```
We'll wire this into the rollout controller to trigger graceful revert and notify oncall.

mike: Quarantine timer proposal: when triggered, route 90% traffic back to last stable model and quarantine flag for 5m; 2m cooldown before auto-retry. Does that align with rollout-controller capabilities?

raj.k: That aligns. Add the timers to INF-1245/1247. Also please include a small simulation in the PR that replays the postmortem traffic spike so we can validate revert semantics.

sophia: Will add simulation + unit tests to the rollback controller PR.

ana: I'll update the flag registry and add a migration note for existing flags (mark risky ones as safe_default=false unless reviewed).

mike: I'll coordinate with infra for creds, and schedule a 30m verification run in staging next Tue.

raj.k: Great. Weekly sync: Fri 10am — quick 15m to verify progress. If you prefer earlier, ping me. Thx all. :rocket:
